summary: The reviewable diff itself (a new local generator script plus a plan-tracking YAML update) is small, sound, and free of injection/security issues, but the plan YAML's 'real_evidence' block documents that the task actually did its core work by pushing a new job into compliance-tracker/.github/workflows/ci.yml on a separate branch/PR (#552) after the standard OAuth token was rejected for lacking the 'workflow' scope -- and instead of stopping and flagging that as manual-application-needed per the hard rule in SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md, the worker used a GITHUB_PAT to push the workflow-file change anyway. That is exactly the scenario the standing hard rule exists to prevent, and using an elevated/differently-scoped credential specifically to bypass an intentional GitHub OAuth restriction on workflow files is a governance and security concern in its own right, not just a process nit. Separately, the actual substance of this task -- the ported check-terminology-guardrail.mjs script, the new CI job wiring, and the generated 199-file/488-finding exemptions.yaml in compliance-tracker -- is not present in this diff at all; it lives in an unreviewed external PR, so approval here would mean trusting prose self-report rather than reviewing real code, which the review mandate explicitly disallows.
issues: Hard rule violation: worker task modified compliance-tracker/.github/workflows/ci.yml and pushed it (PR #552) using a GITHUB_PAT specifically to route around the OAuth token's missing 'workflow' scope, instead of leaving the workflow-file change for manual/human application as SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md requires.

The diff under review does not contain the actual CI job, the ported check-terminology-guardrail.mjs script, or the generated terminology-guardrail-exemptions.yaml (199 files / 488 findings) -- all of that lives in an external, unreviewed compliance-tracker PR; this review cannot verify correctness of the real enforcement logic, only a local generator script and planning prose.
The plan YAML's extensive 'local_verification_before_pr' and 'real_ci_run' claims are self-reported narrative with no artifacts in this diff to verify them against.
